As a Senior Road Engineer, you will help bridge the gap between conventional road and pavement engineering and next-generation AI-driven infrastructure technology. You will contribute to road assessment methodologies, validate engineering outputs, lead projects, and help build technology that can operate at scale across large road networks. If you are passionate about pavement engineering, highway infrastructure, road assessment, and applying technology to real-world infrastructure challenges, this is an opportunity to create meaningful impact. title: Performance Marketing Expert
description:
JOB TITLE: Performance Marketing Expert - Google Ads LOCATION: Pune-Hybrid (In-office every Wednesday) WORKING HOURS: 12:00 PM 9:00 PM IST EXPERIENCE: 8+ Years 
 ABOUT THE ROLE: We are seeking a highly experienced Performance Marketing Expert Google Ads to own and drive paid acquisition and B2B lead generation initiatives end-to-end. This is a hands-on, independent role for a performance marketing professional who can take ownership of a significant advertising budget, target, and account with minimal supervision. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Google Ads, Search, Shopping, Display, Performance Max, YouTube, GA4, and Google Tag Manager (GTM), along with strong capabilities in conversion tracking, attribution, and campaign optimization. The primary mandate is to generate a qualified pipeline from CTOs, CIOs, CDOs, VP Engineering, and other senior technology decision-makers at mid-market consumer companies, primarily in the US market. The role will be measured on MQLs, SQLs, pipeline, and revenue impact, rather than clicks, impressions, or traffic alone. We are looking for a self-driven performance marketer who treats paid media like a business, continuously identifies opportunities for optimization, and can independently diagnose and solve campaign, tracking, and performance challenges. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 B2B Lead Generation & Paid Media Strategy Own the end-to-end paid search strategy for generating qualified B2B pipeline.
• Develop campaigns targeting CTOs, CIOs, CDOs, VP Engineering, and other technical/executive decision-makers.
• Build audience, keyword, targeting, and messaging strategies aligned with technical executive personas.
• Structure paid campaigns around the complete funnel: Awareness MQL SQL Opportunity Revenue.
• Develop targeting strategies using relevant firmographic attributes, job titles, company size, industry, intent signals, and geographic targeting.
• Continuously optimize targeting to improve lead quality and pipeline contribution, not simply lead volume.
• Work closely with Sales and RevOps teams to align on lead scoring, MQL/SQL definitions, lead quality, and sales hand-off criteria.
• Partner with Content and ABM teams to align paid campaigns, landing pages, messaging, and named-account strategies.
• Identify new paid acquisition opportunities and continuously test new approaches. 
 Google Ads Management Plan, build, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns across Search, Shopping, Display, Performance Max, and YouTube.
• Own Google Ads account architecture, campaign structure, targeting, and budget allocation.
• Develop and manage comprehensive keyword strategies.
• Manage match types, negative keyword lists, search terms, Quality Score, ad relevance, and landing page relevance.
• Develop and test multiple ad variations and messaging approaches.
• Manage advanced bidding strategies including Target CPA, Target ROAS, Maximize Conversions, and other relevant automated bidding strategies.
• Monitor campaign and account health regularly.
• Analyze and troubleshoot changes in spend, CPC, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, Quality Score, and impression share.
• Manage budget pacing and reallocation across campaigns based on performance.
• Conduct structured A/B testing across ad copy, targeting, landing pages, bidding strategies, and campaign structures.
• Stay updated on Google Ads policy changes, platform updates, new features, and betas and proactively implement relevant opportunities. 
 GA4 & Conversion Tracking Own and maintain Google Analytics 4 (GA4) configuration for paid media measurement.
• Configure and manage events, conversion events, custom dimensions, custom metrics, audiences, funnels, and exploration reports.
• Implement and QA conversion tracking for form submissions, calls, website conversions, e-commerce actions where applicable, and offline conversions.
• Ensure accurate integration between Google Ads, GA4, GTM, and CRM systems.
• Analyze user journeys and conversion paths to identify performance opportunities.
• Troubleshoot discrepancies between Google Ads, GA4, GTM, and CRM data.
• Support attribution and measurement initiatives for multi-touch B2B sales journeys.
• Ensure paid media performance is measured against qualified business outcomes. 
 Google Tag Manager (GTM) & Tracking Infrastructure Independently configure and manage Google Tag Manager containers.
• Create and manage tags, triggers, variables, custom events, and conversion tracking.
• Define and maintain website data layer requirements.
• Work with developers to implement and validate tracking requirements.
• Use custom JavaScript/data layer variables where required.
• QA tracking implementations before and after website releases.
• Identify and resolve tracking gaps, broken tags, duplicate events, and attribution discrepancies.
• Maintain clean and reliable tracking infrastructure across the marketing funnel.
• Ensure data consistency between GTM GA4 Google Ads CRM. 
 Analytics, Attribution & Reporting Build and maintain performance dashboards using Looker Studio or similar reporting platforms.
• Connect and analyze Google Ads and GA4 data to provide a complete view of campaign performance.
• Track key metrics including MQLs, SQLs, MQL-to-SQL conversion, CPL, CPA, ROAS, pipeline contribution, and revenue.
• Implement appropriate UTM structures and campaign tracking standards.
• Analyze conversion paths and attribution across long, multi-touch B2B sales cycles.
• Identify discrepancies and data-quality issues across advertising, analytics, and CRM platforms.
• Translate complex campaign data into clear, actionable recommendations for business stakeholders.
• Provide regular performance reporting focused on business impact rather than vanity metrics. 
 Strategy, Optimization & Budget Management Translate business objectives into measurable paid media strategies.
• Develop campaign forecasts, budgets, and performance targets in collaboration with leadership.
• Monitor spend and optimize budget allocation based on lead quality and revenue potential.
• Identify underperforming campaigns, audiences, keywords, and creatives and take corrective action.
• Continuously test new keywords, audiences, ad messaging, landing pages, bidding strategies, campaign structures, and conversion approaches.
• Evaluate incrementality and attribution to understand the true contribution of paid search.
• Identify opportunities to scale campaigns while maintaining lead quality and commercial efficiency.
• Stay ahead of changes in paid search, measurement, privacy, and advertising technology. 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with Sales, RevOps, Content, Design, Web, ABM, and Marketing teams.
• Work with Sales to understand lead quality and improve campaign targeting.
• Partner with Content and Design teams on ad creative and landing page optimization.
• Work with Web/Engineering teams on tracking, data layer, and conversion implementation.
• Collaborate with RevOps to establish reliable lead attribution and closed-loop reporting.
• Present performance insights and recommendations to leadership and business stakeholders. 
 QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE: .
• 8+ years of hands-on experience in Google Ads / Paid Search / Performance Marketing. Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Technology, or a related field.
• Proven track record of independently managing and optimizing large and complex Google Ads accounts.
• Deep expertise in Google Search Ads, Shopping, Display, Performance Max, YouTube Ads, keyword strategy, bid management, campaign architecture, and Quality Score optimization.
• Strong hands-on expertise with GA4, including event-based tracking, conversions, audiences, and reporting.
• Strong hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager, including tags, triggers, variables, data layers, and custom JavaScript variables.
• Strong understanding of conversion tracking and attribution.
• Experience connecting Google Ads, GA4, GTM, and CRM systems.
• Strong understanding of UTM structures, funnel tracking, and lead attribution.
• Comfortable with spreadsheet-level data analysis, including formulas, pivot tables, and performance modelling.
• Experience with Looker Studio or similar dashboarding tools.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
• Proven experience with B2B lead generation, preferably targeting technical and executive personas.
• Experience with long, multi-touch B2B sales cycles and connecting paid media performance to MQL, SQL, pipeline, and revenue.
• Ability to independently own strategy, execution, optimization, reporting, and performance improvement. 
 SKILLS & COMPETENCIES: Expert-level Google Ads / Paid Search expertise.
• Strong B2B demand-generation mindset.
• Advanced campaign architecture and optimization capabilities.
• Strong GA4 & GTM expertise.
• Strong conversion tracking and attribution knowledge.
• Data-driven decision-making and analytical skills.
• Strong understanding of lead-generation funnels and revenue attribution.
• Advanced keyword research and targeting capabilities.
• Strong experimentation and A/B testing mindset.
• Strong budget management and forecasting skills.
• Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
• Ability to independently identify performance gaps and implement solutions.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Highly self-driven and comfortable operating with minimal supervision.
• Strong commercial mindset with a focus on pipeline and revenue rather than vanity metrics.
• Curious and proactive about emerging Google Ads, analytics, tracking, and performance marketing trends. 
 NICE TO HAVE: Experience with Microsoft Ads (Bing), Meta Ads, or other paid media platforms.
• Experience with GTM Server-Side Tagging.
• Knowledge of Google Consent Mode and privacy-compliant tracking.
• Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Marketo, or similar CRM/marketing automation platforms.
• Basic SQL or scripting knowledge for reporting and data analysis.
• Experience with offline conversion imports and CRM-based conversion optimization.
• Experience with ABM-led paid acquisition campaigns.
• Experience running campaigns focused on the US market.
• Experience targeting enterprise technology decision-makers. 
 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs): MQLs: Qualified leads generated through Google Ads campaigns.
• SQLs: Sales-qualified leads generated through paid media.
• MQL-to-SQL Conversion: Quality and conversion efficiency of paid-generated leads.

• Tracking Accuracy: Reliability and consistency across GTM, GA4, Google Ads, and CRM.
• Budget Efficiency: Effective allocation and scaling of paid media investment.

title: Research Associate - Safe Drinking Water - J-PAL South Asia
company: Abdul Latif Jameel Poverty Action Lab
description:
Job Summary J-PAL South Asia is inviting expressions of interest for upcoming Research Associate (RA) positions across a variety of sectors and geographies. RAs at J-PAL play a central role in managing the implementation of randomized evaluations, working closely with researchers from leading Universities around the world, ensuring that each evaluation is designed and implemented with precision and rigor. Project Description The research team plans to conduct a study in Andhra Pradesh and Odisha to evaluate community perceptions of chlorinated drinking water through taste test experiments to optimize water treatment practices. This study follows efforts by the Ministry of Jal Shakti's Jal Jeevan Mission to provide drinking water tap connections to every rural household by 2028. As part of these efforts, the Jal Jeevan Mission has recently approved the use of a drinking water treatment method called in-line chlorination to provide safe water to rural communities. Members of this research team recently conducted an RCT of in-line chlorination in drinking water schemes in Odisha, finding that it could effectively reduce E. coli contamination at tap connections by 70%. However, further research is needed to understand how in-line chlorination can be optimized for chlorinated water taste preferences across India. This research directly supports the Ministry of Jal Shakti's Jal Jeevan Mission, which aims to provide safe drinking water tap connections to all rural households in India by 2028. The planned study will evaluate taste detection and acceptability thresholds for chlorinated water among villages in Rayagada, Odisha, and Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh. To evaluate this, the team will conduct a series of blinded taste tests with unchlorinated and chlorinated water samples of varying concentrations to determine levels at which participants can correctly identify chlorinated water samples and their rating of the taste/preferences. This research will directly inform future water chlorination projects by setting chlorine concentrations at levels that are preferred by communities while providing effective disinfection. The candidate will work closely with a multidisciplinary research team from Community Welfare Society Hospital Rourkela (Dr. Praveen Sahu), University of Michigan School of Public Health (Dr. Elisa Maffioli), and University of California Berkeley Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering (Dr. Amy Pickering). The candidate will contribute to study design and methods and lead data collection in each study site alongside the research team. Key Responsibilities The responsibilities of a Research Associate typically include, but are not limited to: Supporting researchers in developing and refining study protocols through in-field scoping activities. You will provide contextual and operational insights to help researchers shape experimental protocols that are methodologically rigorous and feasible within the study setting. Strengthening measurement validity and reliability by assisting in the development and piloting of survey instruments. You will be responsible for organizing field tests, analyzing pilot data, and integrating structured feedback loops to improve the precision and accuracy of indicators. Enable accurate and efficient data capture through the programming of digital surveys and development of end-to-end data workflows. This includes incorporating survey logic, real-time checks, and secure data transmission to ensure clean, analysis-ready datasets. Ensuring collection of high-quality primary data-recruiting, training, and managing field teams to collect data that meets rigorous research standards. Safeguarding data integrity in consultation with the research team by setting up and maintaining systems for real-time quality monitoring. You will identify issues in incoming data, identify solutions in collaboration with the researchers, and implement corrective measures. Preparing analysis-ready datasets by writing reproducible code (in Stata, R, or Python), generating summary statistics, and contributing to the analytical preparation for publications, working closely with researchers. Facilitating alignment between research teams and implementation partners to ensure that project implementation aligns with study protocols. You will coordinate timelines, share updates across teams, and help troubleshoot day-to-day challenges while maintaining strong working relationships with external stakeholders. Ensuring transparency and reproducibility by developing and maintaining detailed documentation, including codebooks, field protocols, and project logs that align with academic standards and support eventual replication and publication. Maintaining strict adherence to J-PAL's research protocols throughout all stages of the research lifecycle. What We're Looking For Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to addressing operational and analytical challenges Ability to manage day-to-day work with minimal supervision Excellent time management and attention to detail Ability to navigate fast-evolving settings that require flexibility and initiative Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt messaging for diverse audiences Required Knowledge and Skills A Bachelor's/Master's degree in economics, sociology, social sciences, public policy, public health or related fields. Other technical degrees with focus on engineering, water supply and treatment, or civil engineering will also be considered. Sound understanding of impact evaluation methods, especially randomized controlled trials (RCTs) Proficiency in data analysis and statistical tools such as R (preferred) or Stata. Experience with digital data collection platforms such as SurveyCTO (preferred) or Qualtrics. Fluency in English and Hindi; proficiency in one or more regional languages (Odia or Telugu) is a strong asset Willingness to travel extensively and stay in field locations. This is a multi-site study requiring extensive travel to Rayagada, Odisha, and Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh. Experience working with external stakeholders such as government departments or NGOs is a plus . Note on Work Authorizations Candidates must have work authorization to work in India. Length of Commitment Full-time, 9-month position with possible extension

description:

Proactively flag oversold, unavailable, or discontinued items and recommend suitable alternatives to Sales and E-commerce. Source alternative units including modification or replacement options when an ordered product is out of stock or non-working. Act as the primary point of technical escalation for Sales, Procurement, and E-commerce; handle direct client technical queries via email, phone, and WhatsApp. 
 Protect Every Customer Touchpoint Audit product listings across all portals for part number, specification, image, condition, quantity, price, and description accuracy. Cross-check Email and WhatsApp conversations of Purchase and Sales Department for accuracy, professionalism, and response-time (TAT) compliance. Verify quotations, Proforma Invoices, and order confirmations product links, pricing, quantity, warranty terms, shipping, and currency before anything reaches the customer. Identify recurring communication or documentation errors and drive corrective action to stop repeated mistakes. 
 Keep Shipments and Cash Moving Run pre-dispatch checks on condition, quantity, and packaging; review sold orders daily with Sales and Marketing. Track pending shipments, coordinate DHL/FedEx returns, and chase stuck or delayed shipments through to resolution. Support customs-related matters and escalate critical shipment or clearance issues promptly. Own the return, refund, and credit-term process end-to-end, coordinating with Accounts and Logistics. 
 Build the Systems Behind the Scenes Maintain and analyze Sales and performance data (AMT, A2M, AM), preparing figures and reports for decision-making. Maintain vendor registration forms and official documentation requiring authorized signatures and stamps. Maintain accurate records of dispatched, pending, returned, stuck, and customs-hold shipments; verify client data against approved lists. 
 Lead Without Waiting for a Title Coordinate across Sales, Accounts, Procurement, Logistics, and E-commerce to resolve operational issues and keep workflow smooth. Step into routine responsibilities of the Sales Head, Purchase Head, or other senior leads when they're unavailable. Lead product/technical training and Training Needs Analysis (TNA) sessions to close skill gaps across the team. Monitor daily reporting channels and deliver consolidated performance reporting to management. Who We're Looking For Solid experience in a technical, quality, or operations role — ideally where you own outcomes across more than one function, not just your own lane. Industrial products, e-commerce, or parts distribution background is a strong plus. A low tolerance for "close enough" — inconsistent listings, vague quotes, and stuck shipments bother you until they're fixed. Comfortable holding other teams accountable without built-in authority over them — through data, credibility, and follow-through, not hierarchy. Strong analytical and documentation instincts, with the ability to switch between hands-on troubleshooting and management-level reporting in the same day. Engineering or technical degree preferred — but a proven track record matters more than the paper. 
 Must-Have Capabilities Technical product identification and cross-referencing Industrial/electrical/electronic product understanding Quality auditing Quotation/PI/order verification Excel/MIS/data analysis Logistics escalation Strong documentation Root-cause analysis Cross-functional coordination Team accountability Good written and verbal communication High attention to detail 
 Nice-to-Have Capabilities E-commerce / marketplace experience eBay / Shopify / BigCommerce exposure DHL / FedEx / customs experience Marine / industrial automation background Zoho / ERP experience Training / TNA experience

In line with our strategy, Sustainable Success with Customers, we will focus on increasing the value we create for customers with new intelligent solutions and embed sustainability even deeper across all of our operations. By closer collaboration with customers and partners, KONE will increase the speed of bringing new services and solutions to the market. KONE Technology and Innovation Unit (KTI) is where we combine the physical world – escalators and elevators – with smart and connected digital systems. We are changing and improving the way billions of people move within buildings every day. We are on a mission to expand and develop new digital solutions that are based on emerging technologies. KONE IT is a global team of expert professionals working along with business functions and area teams to develop new capabilities and enable new business opportunities. We are trusted partners of KONE business lines and functions to develop, transform, manage and run their information technology solutions. We support KONE in its digital transformation journey by introducing e.g. digital cloud-based IT services, artificial intelligence (AI) and automation to support productivity, business growth and technological disruption.Sustainability, curious mindset and innovation areat the core of everything we do, and this makes us an integral part ofKONE’s success. Main responsibilities  BI Product Design & User Collaboration   Analyze business and user needs, translating them into BI product concepts, functional specifications, and backlog items.  Work with product owners, process owners, and key users to define requirements and acceptance criteria.  Take ownership of the design and conceptualization of BI dashboards, data models, and analytical product Design fitforpurpose and fitforuse BI solutions that consider both functional (analytics, usability, accessibility) and nonfunctional (security, performance, scalability) requirements. Troubleshoot issues related to BI data sources, model performance, and platform connectivity.  Monitor & Optimize BI solutions for performance, scalability, and security.  IT Product Operations Support Operations teams in managing major incidents and other critical issues related to BI product operations. Communicate proactively—raising blockers, risks, and design concerns early. Contribute to iterative delivery, focusing on incremental value rather than large one-off deliveries. Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized.
